newsitem.title: NIGERIA: Ethiopian premier to visit Nigeria next week.
newsitem.headline: Ethiopian premier to visit Nigeria next week.

text.p: Ethiopian Prime Minister Meles Zenawi will begin a two-day official visit to Nigeria on Monday, the Nigerian government news agency reported on Saturday.
It said Zenawi would fly into the capital Abuja with a team that would include Ethiopian businessmen and the general manager of Ethiopian Airlines.
He would hold talks with military ruler General Sani Abacha and tour a company that manufactures biscuits in the northern Nigerian city of Jos.
Zenawi will be the second prime minister this month to visit Nigeria, Africa's most populous nation which is shunned by the West for alleged human rights abuses and lack of democracy.
Prime Minister Necmettin Erbakan of Turkey was in Abuja two weeks ago and the two countries signed a broad range of economic agreements.
